objective: Find out whether an existing, maintained pi (pi coding agent) extension or package already provides a full Kimi for Coding (global) integration.
scope: Maintainer question (verbatim): "btw for the kimi provider in pi, check if there is any already existent and maintained pi extension for full kimi for coding global integration".

Context: pi is the coding agent researched in /home/user/holyagent/docs/pi/ (read docs/pi/README.md, extensions.md and providers.md first for its package names, extension and provider APIs and the built-in provider ids kimi-coding, moonshotai and moonshotai-cn). Kimi for Coding is Moonshot AI's coding subscription; 'global' means the international service, not the China one.

Search the web (Exa search and fetch tools if you have them), npm, GitHub and pi's own documentation, package lists or examples for: (1) whether pi's built-in kimi-coding provider already is the full global Kimi for Coding integration (endpoint, auth, models, thinking, caching); (2) third-party pi extensions or pi packages for Kimi for Coding or Moonshot. For each candidate give: name and URL, what it supplies (provider registration, login or OAuth, model list, thinking levels, prompt caching, usage or quota display), global vs China endpoint, last release or commit date, maintainer, open issues, license, and whether it targets the pi version family the repo pins.
Judge 'maintained' by evidence: releases or commits in the last few months, responses to issues. Separate sourced facts from inference.
constraints: Read-only: write no files and make no git writes. Put your full answer in the report itself.

Keep working until done; stop and report. Report in under 450 words: a verdict line first (use existing X / built-in is enough / nothing maintained exists), then the candidates with their evidence and URLs, then what a pi integration would still need to build.

criteria.text: The verdict on an existing maintained pi extension for Kimi for Coding global is backed by dated, linked evidence

result:
Verdict: use existing `pi-provider-kimi-code` (Leechael) on top of pi's built-in `kimi-coding` provider. Nothing else I found is both maintained and complete.

**1. Built-in `kimi-coding`**
- Facts (earendil-works/pi `packages/ai/src/providers/kimi-coding.ts`, https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/blob/209bc7b9/packages/ai/src/providers/kimi-coding.ts):
  - It uses `api.kimi.com/coding` with the anthropic-messages API.
  - Auth is `KIMI_API_KEY` or the "Kimi Code (subscription)" OAuth.
  - Its models are `k3`, `kimi-for-coding` and `kimi-for-coding-highspeed`.
- Per the Leechael README, built-in `kimi-coding` has existed since pi v0.82.0. It covers model discovery, reasoning controls and OAuth login, but does not provide the extras below.
- Inference: it is good enough for plain chat. I did not verify its caching behaviour.

**2. Candidates**

| Package | Evidence | Verdict |
|---|---|---|
| `pi-provider-kimi-code` (Leechael), npm https://pi.dev/packages/pi-provider-kimi-code, repo https://github.com/Leechael/pi-provider-kimi-code | v0.6.13 on 2026-10-05. About 9 releases between 2026-07-16 and 2026-10-05. MIT. Bumped to pi 0.99.2, which is the 0.99 family `docs/pi/providers.md` lists. | Best candidate, maintained. |
| `@zgltyq/pi-provider-kimi-code` (https://pi.dev/packages/@zgltyq/pi-provider-kimi-code) | v0.4.1 on 2026-07-27. Fork for an `x-api-key` 401 bug. Targets `@mariozechner/*` packages. | Stale. |
| `pi-kimi-coder` (picassio, https://github.com/picassio/pi-kimi-coder) | v1.1.1 on 2026-07-13. MIT. Registers its own `kimi-coder` provider on K2.6 models. Needs pi 0.50 or later. | Superseded by the built-in. |
| `@ramarivera/pi-kimi-for-coding` | v0.1.8 on 2026-05-09. Sends CLI fingerprint headers and `prompt_cache_key`. | Old. |
| `kimicodeprovider` | v0.1.0 on 2026-01-28. Uses a `MOONSHOT_API_KEY` and a custom base URL. | Abandoned, no OAuth. |
| `@ersintarhan/pi-toolkit` (https://github.com/ersintarhan/pi-toolkit) | Bundle of unrelated tools that includes a Kimi provider. | Poor fit. |
| `pi-kimi-usage` (muffe, https://github.com/muffe/pi-kimi-usage) | Footer showing 5-hour and 7-day quota from `/coding/v1/usages`. I did not check its release date. | Small, usage display only. |

**What `pi-provider-kimi-code` supplies** (from its README and release notes):
- Credential sharing with the official `kimi-code` CLI.
- `/login kimi-coding` OAuth, plus a `KIMI_API_KEY` fallback.
- Files API uploads for large images.
- Optional Kimi-native tools: `moonshot_search`, `moonshot_fetch` and `kimi_datasource`.
- Tool-schema dedup to stay under Moonshot's 15 KB per-tool limit.
- Quota (`/usages`) parsing and a `/kimi-settings` command.
- Prompt-cache key and reasoning-level mapping (documented in its architecture doc).

**Global vs China**
- The README says `api.kimi.com` is mainland-cn and `api.kimi.ai` is global.
- It adds region switching through `KIMI_CODE_REGION`, shipped in v0.6.13 (fixes issue #77).
- This conflicts with the built-in's `api.kimi.com` base URL. The built-in has no region switching, per the same README. I did not verify which host is actually global; that needs checking before relying on it.

**Caveats**
- The Leechael README names Kimi K3 and K2.8 as current models. These are the model names the sources use, and I did not check them against Moonshot's own documentation.
- Open issue #16 (tool schema rejected as invalid Moonshot JSON schema) was opened 2026-06-03. The release notes mention schema dedup, but I did not confirm it resolves #16.
- The only maintainer is Leechael, with one outside contributor (iRonin), so this is a single-maintainer risk.
- I did not check the npm download counts for pi.dev's `pi-provider-kimi-code`. The page showed about 1.4k per month.

**What an integration would still need**
- Verify the global endpoint. Set `KIMI_CODE_REGION` explicitly.
- Pin the extension version against the repo's pi 0.99.x.
- Treat the extension's legacy `kimi-coding` registration as overriding the built-in provider of the same id.
- Decide whether to enable the Kimi-native server-side tools, since they send data to Moonshot's services.

result: use existing `pi-provider-kimi-code`
changed: none
blockers: none

It has about 9 releases since 2026-07-16 and tracks pi 0.99.2. The built-in is at https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/blob/209bc7b9/packages/ai/src/providers/kimi-coding.ts.
